title: Shader slot selection with ordered overrides
summary: Recover VA 0x5301b0 as a 32-bit thiscall member: flags at +0x2862 and +0x2863 select table entries 228 and 229 in that priority order; otherwise use the unchecked caller index in the table at +0xe18. Returns an opaque shader pointer and writes nothing.
test_description: Compare original and recovered return values for all 25 flag pairs from 0,1,2,128,255, sixteen ordinary and wrapping indices, and two table bases. Include null and high-bit pointer values, override precedence, slots used by direct callers, and modulo-32-bit address scaling. Snapshot the entire partial object and table and verify both remain unchanged after each call.
known_limits: Partial manager layout and opaque shader type; exact class and override names unresolved.
Requires 32-bit pointers, matching the original ABI. No bounds or null checks: selected addresses must be readable. Invalid memory faults are not executed in tests.
Rendering, shader lifetime, concurrency and indirect caller coverage are outside this bounded routine.
Behavioral recovery only; no byte matching claim.
